'''Adam Kanigowski''' (born 15 April 1989)<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Adam Kanigowski laureatem Nagrody im. Kazimierza Kuratowskiego 2017 {{!}} Polskie Towarzystwo Matematyczne |url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/zawartosc/adam-kanigowski-laureatem-nagrody-im-kazimierza-kuratowskiego-2017 |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www.ptm.org.pl}}</ref> is a Polish mathematician specializing in [[dynamical systems]] and [[ergodic theory]]. He is a professor at the [[University of Maryland]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Mathematics - Kanigowski, Adam M. |url=https://www-math.umd.edu/people/faculty/item/1393-akanigow.html |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www-math.umd.edu |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Education ==
Kanigowski was born in [[Toruń]].<ref name=":0" /> He earned his master's degree in mathematics from the [[Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń]] in 2012,<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Department of Mathematics - Adam Kanigowski Awarded European Mathematical Society Prize |url=https://www-math.umd.edu/about-us/math-news/1078-adam-kanigowski-awarded-european-mathematical-society-prize.html |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www-math.umd.edu}}</ref> and his Ph.D. in 2015 from the [[Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences]], under the supervision of [[Mariusz Lemańczyk]] and Joanna Kułaga-Przymus.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Adam Kanigowski - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=233544 |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> His dissertation was entitled ''Własności ergodyczne gładkich potoków na powierzchniach'' (''Ergodic properties of smooth flows on surfaces'') and awarded the [[Polish Mathematical Society#International Stefan Banach Prize|International Stefan Banach Prize]] in 2016.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |title=Laureates |url=https://ibp.ptm.org.pl/laureaci/ |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=THE INTERNATIONAL STEFAN BANACH PRIZE |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Career and research ==
After graduating, Kanigowski joined [[Pennsylvania State University|Penn State University]] as an S. Chowla Research Assistant Professor in 2015 and then joined [[University of Maryland, College Park|UMD]] as an assistant professor in 2018, where he was promoted to full professor in 2024. Since December 2022, Kanigowski has led a flagship project at [[Jagiellonian University]] that partly supports a research collaboration with UMD.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":6" />

Kanigowski's research interests include dynamical systems and ergodic theory as well as their interaction with [[number theory]], [[geometry]] and [[probability theory]]. In particular, he is interested in [[randomness]] and [[Chaos theory|chaos]] in smooth dynamical systems, classification problems in abstract ergodic theory, and non-standard ergodic theorems that find application in number theory. Together with collaborators, he solved several longstanding open problems and conjuctures, such as the [[Vladimir Abramovich Rokhlin|Rokhlin]] problem, the [[Peter Sarnak|Sarnak]] hypothesis, the [[Anatole Katok|Katok]] hypothesis and the [[Marina Ratner|Ratner]] problem.<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |title=News - Jagiellonian University - Jagiellonian University |url=https://en.uj.edu.pl/en_GB/news/-/journal_content/56_INSTANCE_SxA5QO0R5BDs/81541894/156502839 |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=en.uj.edu.pl}}</ref>

Kanigowski has published more than 30 papers in premier mathematical journals including the most prestigious ones, such as [[Annals of Mathematics]], [[Journal of the American Mathematical Society]], and [[Inventiones Mathematicae]].<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |title=Adam Kanigowski - Author Profile - zbMATH Open |url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=kanigowski |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=zbmath.org}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> Among his collaborators are [[Dmitry Dolgopyat]], Bassam Fayad, [[Giovanni Forni]], [[Mariusz Lemańczyk]], [[Maksym Radziwill|Maksym Radziwiłł]], [[Federico Rodriguez Hertz]], and [[Corinna Ulcigrai]].<ref name=":5" />

==Recognition==
In 2015, the [[Polish Mathematical Society]] gave Kanigowski their Prize for Young Mathematicians (he was awarded for a series of six papers in the field of ergodic theory and [[operator theory]]).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Adam Kanigowski {{!}} Polskie Towarzystwo Matematyczne |url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/laureaci/adam-kanigowski |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www.ptm.org.pl}}</ref>  He was the 2016 winner of the International Stefan Banach Prize for a doctoral dissertation in the mathematical sciences.<ref name=":4" /> In 2017 he received the Kazimierz Kuratowski Award from the Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences and the Polish Mathematical Society.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kazimierz Kuratowski Award |url=https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/kazimierz-kuratowski |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www.impan.pl |archive-date=2024-11-11  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241111194139/https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/kazimierz-kuratowski |url-status=dead }}</ref> In March 2024, the [[Simons Foundation]] named Kanigowski a 2024 Simons Fellow in Mathematics,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-20 |title=2024 Simons Fellows in Mathematics Announced |url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/2024/03/20/2024-simons-fellows-in-mathematics-announced/ |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=Simons Foundation |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> in April he received the  Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences Prize for outstanding scientific achievements in mathematics for his "fundamental results in the field of dynamical systems and ergodic theory",<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences Prize for outstanding scientific achievements in mathematics |url=https://www.impan.pl/en/activities/awards/outstanding-scientific-achievements-in-mathematics |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www.impan.pl}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> and in July he was awarded the [[EMS Prize]] for "his outstanding contributions to the spectral classification and the mixing properties of slowly chaotic dynamical systems".<ref>{{Cite web |title=EMS {{!}} Fourteen prizes awarded to European mathematicians at the 9th ECM |url=https://euromathsoc.org/news/fourteen-prizes-awarded-to-european-mathematicians-at-the-9th-ecm-121 |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=euromathsoc.org |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1" />

== Personal life ==
Adam Kanigowski has two daughters.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Wielki sukces matematyków z Polski. Jendrej i Kanigowski z prestiżową nagrodą |url=https://www.rmf24.pl/nauka/news-wielki-sukces-matematykow-z-polski-jendrej-i-kanigowski-z-pr,nId,7655198 |access-date=2024-07-19 |website=www.rmf24.pl |language=pl}}</ref> In June 2024 he finished his first [[Ironman Triathlon|Ironman triathlon]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3" />
